## Selected projects

- [driftfix](https://github.com/colmeabhi/driftfix): Finds manual AWS console changes that drifted from CloudFormation, has an LLM write the fix, and opens a pull request.
- [Cache-aware scale-in](https://github.com/colmeabhi/cache-aware-scale-in): A Kubernetes controller that tells the cluster which vLLM replica is cheapest to lose when scaling down.
- [Parallel N-body simulation](https://github.com/colmeabhi/parallelized-nbody-simulation-cuda-cpp): A galaxy simulation written five ways, from one CPU thread to tiled CUDA kernels, to compare them like for like.
- AI sprint planning assistant: Turns a planning spreadsheet into Jira tickets with a RAG pipeline and tool calls.
- [SDN load balancer](https://github.com/colmeabhi/sdn-load-balance): An OpenFlow controller that load-balances HTTP traffic with five swappable algorithms.

## Case studies

- [The 2 am fix that CloudFormation undoes](https://colmeabhi.github.io/case-studies/driftfix.md): Someone changes production by hand, and the template in Git quietly stops telling the truth. driftfix notices, has an LLM write the template change, and opens a pull request for a person to decide on. It started as a hackathon win and became a three-person rebuild that I led.
- [Teaching Kubernetes which pod to delete](https://colmeabhi.github.io/case-studies/cache-aware-scale-in.md): When an LLM deployment scales down, Kubernetes removes a replica without knowing which one is holding the useful cache. This is my M.S. project. The first GPU run showed no difference, and why turned out to be the interesting part.
- [One click, one order](https://colmeabhi.github.io/case-studies/idempotent-order-api.md): How I built an order API that survives retries, and the bug in my first version that taught me the difference between checking and claiming.
- [An LLM that could only fill in the blanks](https://colmeabhi.github.io/case-studies/self-service-infra.md): How about fifty data engineers got their own test infrastructure in minutes instead of a day, and why the LLM in the middle was never allowed to write any of it.
